findings.rule: Constitution I.1 / data integrity: one role per Save
findings.trigger: Add mode, valid draft, tap Save twice before the first Saved event. Both coroutines pass the 'finished' check at line 133 before either reaches line 152 (the check is not repeated after observeProfile().first()), both read the same profile, and idAllocator.nextId returns the same id, so two roles with one id are written. ExperienceScreen then uses entryId as a LazyColumn key, so the duplicate key crashes the Experience list.
findings.title: Double Save in add mode writes two roles with the same id
findings.proof: EditRoleViewModelTest: new role with a valid draft, call save() twice before collecting events, then assert the saved profile has exactly one new entry.

findings.rule: 281-c8: criteria in scope have tests that can fail
findings.trigger: The PR criteria list EditRoleViewModelTest.deleteInAddMode_isNoop, but no such test exists. Removing the 'entryId ?: return' guard in delete() leaves every test green.
findings.title: deleteInAddMode_isNoop is claimed but missing
findings.proof: Add a test: viewModel(null).delete() emits no event and leaves the saved profile equal to the original.

findings.rule: D52 / I.1: do not state what cannot be derived
findings.trigger: A profile whose only role has a blank or unparsable end date (the required-gap case) shows '0 yrs'. Line 88 skips the role, so the sum is 0 and the header claims zero years. ProfileOverviewTest.blankEndDate/unparsableEndDate pin this behaviour.
findings.title: Roles with unparsable end dates are skipped and can produce a misleading '0 yrs'

findings.trigger: A bullet typed or imported as '  spaced  ' is saved as 'spaced' (bulletLimits_enforced asserts this). Only whitespace is lost, so this is a minor deviation from verbatim storage.
findings.title: Bullet text is trimmed on save
